```{r data}
#| results: asis
library(plotly)
source("scripts/shared.R")

senators <- load_senators()
ns       <- senator_name_sets(senators)
votes    <- load_all_votes(ns)
bills    <- load_bills() |> bill_statuses(votes)
contribs <- load_all_contributions()

sen_link <- function(name, district) {
  sprintf('<a href="%s/district_%s.html">%s</a>', SENATOR_PAGES_DIR, district, name)
}
lb <- function(label, ranks, names, amounts) {
  cat('<div class="lb-block"><div class="lb-label">', label, '</div><ol class="leaderboard">',
      paste(sprintf('<li><span class="lb-rank">%s</span><span class="lb-name">%s</span><span class="lb-amt">%s</span></li>',
                    ranks, names, amounts), collapse = ""),
      '</ol></div>', sep = "")
}
```

## The Money

```{r money}
#| results: asis
if (nrow(contribs) > 0) {
  total   <- sum(contribs$Contribution, na.rm = TRUE)
  biggest <- contribs |> filter(!is.na(Contribution)) |> slice_max(Contribution, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  big_who <- senators |> filter(District == biggest$Recipient.District)
  big_txt <- sprintf("%s → %s, %s",
                     html_link(biggest$Lobby_Code, lobby_url(biggest$Lobby_Code)),
                     if (nrow(big_who) > 0) sen_link(big_who$Name, big_who$District)
                     else htmltools::htmlEscape(biggest$Recipient.Name),
                     format(biggest$Date, "%b %d"))

  cat(sprintf('
<div class="stat-strip">
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Total Contributed</span><span class="stat-value">%s</span><span class="stat-sub">across %d contributions</span></div>
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Largest Single Gift</span><span class="stat-value">%s</span><span class="stat-sub">%s</span></div>
</div>', scales::dollar(total), nrow(contribs), scales::dollar(biggest$Contribution), big_txt))

  cat('<div class="lb-cols">')

  # Senators who received the most
  top_received <- contribs |>
    filter(!is.na(Recipient.District)) |>
    group_by(Recipient.District) |>
    summarize(total = sum(Contribution, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    left_join(senators |> select(District, Name, Party), by = c("Recipient.District" = "District")) |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(total))) |>
    filter(rank <= 5)
  lb("Deepest Pockets — Most Money Received",
     top_received$rank,
     sprintf("%s (%s-%d)", sen_link(top_received$Name, top_received$Recipient.District),
             top_received$Party, top_received$Recipient.District),
     scales::dollar(top_received$total))

  # Lobbies that spent the most
  top_spent <- contribs |>
    group_by(Lobby_Code, Lobby) |>
    summarize(total = sum(Contribution, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(total)) |>
    mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(total))) |>
    filter(rank <= 5)
  lb("Biggest Spenders",
     top_spent$rank,
     html_link(ifelse(is.na(top_spent$Lobby), top_spent$Lobby_Code, top_spent$Lobby),
               lobby_url(top_spent$Lobby_Code)),
     scales::dollar(top_spent$total))

  cat('</div>')
  cat('<div class="lb-label">Money Over Time</div>')
} else {
  cat('<p>No contributions have been reported yet.</p>')
}
```

```{r money-chart}
#| fig-height: 3.2
if (nrow(contribs) > 0) {
  daily <- contribs |>
    filter(!is.na(Date)) |>
    arrange(Date) |>
    group_by(Date) |>
    summarize(day_total = sum(Contribution, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    mutate(cumulative = cumsum(day_total))

  plot_ly(daily, x = ~Date, y = ~cumulative, type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers",
          line = list(color = "#17345a", width = 2.5),
          marker = list(color = "#d4a821", size = 6),
          fill = "tozeroy", fillcolor = "rgba(23,52,90,0.08)",
          hovertemplate = "%{x|%b %d}: %{y:$,.0f}<extra></extra>") |>
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = "", gridcolor = "rgba(23,52,90,0.08)"),
      yaxis = list(title = "", tickprefix = "$", gridcolor = "rgba(23,52,90,0.08)"),
      plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font = list(family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible"),
      margin = list(t = 10, b = 30, l = 60, r = 20)
    ) |>
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}
```

## The Votes

```{r loyalty}
#| results: asis
if (length(votes) > 0) {
  # Per senator: votes cast, votes with their party's plurality, misses
  loyalty <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(senators)), function(i) {
    s <- senators[i, ]
    choice_col <- if (s$Party == "D") "Dem_choice" else "Rep_choice"
    cast <- 0; agree <- 0; missed <- 0
    for (df in votes) {
      if (!s$name_period %in% names(df)) next
      v  <- df[[s$name_period]]
      ch <- df[[choice_col]]
      is_cast <- !is.na(v) & v %in% c("Aye", "No", "Abstain")
      cast   <- cast + sum(is_cast)
      agree  <- agree + sum(is_cast & v == ch, na.rm = TRUE)
      missed <- missed + sum(is.na(v) | v == "")
    }
    data.frame(Name = s$Name, District = s$District, Party = s$Party,
               cast = cast, agree = agree, missed = missed)
  })) |>
    mutate(pct = ifelse(cast >= 5, round(100 * agree / cast), NA))

  eligible <- loyalty |> filter(!is.na(pct))

  cat('<div class="lb-cols">')
  for (p in c("D", "R")) {
    top <- eligible |> filter(Party == p) |>
      arrange(desc(pct), desc(cast)) |>
      mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(pct))) |>
      filter(rank <= 3)
    lb(paste0("Most Loyal ", ifelse(p == "D", "Democrats", "Republicans")),
       top$rank,
       sen_link(top$Name, top$District),
       sprintf("%d%% of %d votes", top$pct, top$cast))
  }
  cat('</div><div class="lb-cols">')

  mavericks <- eligible |>
    arrange(pct, desc(cast)) |>
    mutate(rank = dense_rank(pct)) |>
    filter(rank <= 3)
  lb("The Mavericks — Most Votes Against Party",
     mavericks$rank,
     sprintf("%s (%s)", sen_link(mavericks$Name, mavericks$District), mavericks$Party),
     sprintf("%d%% with party", mavericks$pct))

  most_missed <- loyalty |>
    filter(missed > 0) |>
    arrange(desc(missed)) |>
    mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(missed))) |>
    filter(rank <= 3)
  if (nrow(most_missed) > 0) {
    lb("Most Missed Votes",
       most_missed$rank,
       sprintf("%s (%s)", sen_link(most_missed$Name, most_missed$District), most_missed$Party),
       sprintf("%d missed", most_missed$missed))
  }
  cat('</div>')
} else {
  cat('<p>No votes have been taken yet.</p>')
}
```

## The Bills

```{r bills}
#| results: asis
n_passed <- sum(bills$status == "Passed Senate")
n_failed <- sum(grepl("^Failed", bills$status))
n_moving <- nrow(bills) - n_passed - n_failed

cat(sprintf('
<div class="stat-strip">
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Bills Introduced</span><span class="stat-value">%d</span></div>
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Passed the Senate</span><span class="stat-value">%d</span></div>
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Failed</span><span class="stat-value">%d</span></div>
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Still Moving</span><span class="stat-value">%d</span></div>
</div>', nrow(bills), n_passed, n_failed, n_moving))
```

## Fundraising

Every senator has a fundraising goal set by their district's electoral
circumstances; every lobbying organization has one PAC budget for the
session and may give at most `r scales::dollar(CONTRIBUTION_LIMIT)` to any
one senator.

```{r fundraising}
#| results: asis
library(reactable)
fin <- senator_finance(senators, contribs)
cat(sprintf('
<div class="stat-strip">
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">All Goals Combined</span><span class="stat-value">%s</span></div>
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">Raised So Far</span><span class="stat-value">%s</span><span class="stat-sub">%s%% of all goals</span></div>
  <div class="stat"><span class="stat-label">PAC Money Available</span><span class="stat-value">%s</span><span class="stat-sub">%s%% of what senators need</span></div>
</div>',
  scales::dollar(sum(fin$Goal, na.rm = TRUE)), scales::dollar(sum(fin$Raised)),
  round(100 * sum(fin$Raised) / sum(fin$Goal, na.rm = TRUE)),
  scales::dollar(sum(load_budgets()$Budget, na.rm = TRUE)),
  round(100 * sum(load_budgets()$Budget, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(fin$Goal, na.rm = TRUE))))
```

### Senators: progress toward goal

```{r goals-table}
goal_tbl <- fin |>
  arrange(desc(Pct), District) |>
  transmute(Senator = Name, District, Party, Race, Goal, Raised, Progress = Pct)
legsim_table(goal_tbl, page_size = 40, searchable = FALSE, columns = list(
  Senator  = colDef(cell = link_cell("", sprintf("%s/district_%s.html", SENATOR_PAGES_DIR, goal_tbl$District))),
  District = colDef(width = 80),
  Party    = colDef(width = 65),
  Goal     = colDef(width = 100, format = colFormat(currency = "USD", separators = TRUE, digits = 0)),
  Raised   = colDef(width = 100, format = colFormat(currency = "USD", separators = TRUE, digits = 0)),
  Progress = colDef(width = 150, html = TRUE, cell = function(value) progress_bar_html(value))
))
```

### Organizations: PAC balances

```{r balances-table}
bal <- org_finance(contribs) |>
  arrange(desc(Remaining)) |>
  transmute(Organization = Lobby, Code, Tier, Budget, Spent, Remaining, Used = Pct)
legsim_table(bal, page_size = 20, searchable = FALSE, columns = list(
  Organization = colDef(cell = link_cell("", sprintf("%s/%s.html", LOBBY_PAGES_DIR, bal$Code)), minWidth = 220),
  Code      = colDef(width = 70),
  Tier      = colDef(width = 80),
  Budget    = colDef(width = 100, format = colFormat(currency = "USD", separators = TRUE, digits = 0)),
  Spent     = colDef(width = 100, format = colFormat(currency = "USD", separators = TRUE, digits = 0)),
  Remaining = colDef(width = 105, format = colFormat(currency = "USD", separators = TRUE, digits = 0)),
  Used      = colDef(width = 130, html = TRUE, cell = function(value) progress_bar_html(value))
))
```
